novelty.N3: Research breakthrough, new theorem on an open problem, or strict Pareto dominance over standard engineering baselines
novelty.N2: Novel spectral-free or coordinate-free Lean 4 formalization architecture with new algebraic reductions
novelty.N1: Foundational zero-sorry building block enabling higher-level compositions

applicability.A3: Drop-in production / real-time ready (bound to ctrl.robotics Python, C99/IEC 61131-3 ST codegen, or MuJoCo 3.16.0 benchmark)
applicability.A2: System design, offline synthesis, or prize-submission ready

ideas.title: Spectral-Free Detectable DARE, Infinite-Horizon LQR & Return-Difference Margins
ideas.approach: Forced-observer zero-step escape lemma proving Schur stability and uniqueness of DARE for positive semidefinite Q = C^T C >= 0 without eigenvalues, plus quadratic return-difference disk margins.

ideas.title: Minimal-Hypothesis LQG Separation & Discrete H_infinity Bounded Real Lemma
ideas.approach: Indefinite minimax completion of squares with disturbance Hessian M_gamma(P) = gamma^2 I - D^T D - B^T P B certifying finite- and infinite-horizon l2-gain attenuation <= gamma and worst-case disturbance tightness.
ideas.measured_impact: 39.4% peak and 39.6% RMS tracking error reduction vs. well-tuned high-gain Computed-Torque Control (CTC) under external torque impulses in 6-DOF MuJoCo benchmark (and 99.6% vs uncompensated low-gain PD).

ideas.title: Square-Root-Free Matrix Peter-Paul Input-to-State Stability (ISS)
ideas.approach: Bypasses matrix square roots P^(1/2) via an exact quadratic Peter-Paul identity to convert any discrete Stein Lyapunov equation into an explicit ISS trajectory bound and forward-invariant sublevel set.

ideas.title: Constrained Receding-Horizon MPC Recursive Feasibility & Arimoto ILC
ideas.approach: Shifted-tail terminal-set recursive feasibility, CLF value descent, and lifted Toeplitz Iterative Learning Control geometric convergence.

ideas.title: Strict-Feedback Integrator Backstepping & Sontag's Universal CLF Formula
ideas.approach: Recursive virtual-control error coordinates z_i = x_i - alpha_{i-1} with tridiagonal skew cancellation, paired with Sontag's analytic universal stabilizer guaranteeing dV/dt <= -sqrt(a^2 + b^4).

ideas.title: 3D 4-Contact Bilinear ZMP Wrench Allocator & Lorentz-Cone CBF Safety Filter
ideas.approach: Closed-form conic duality for 3D 4-contact robots: proves exact biconditional deceleration limit min(mu, W/h_G)*g, zero 3D Euler angular-momentum drift (dL/dt = 0), and closed-form SOCP stopping-distance CBF without online QP solvers.
ideas.measured_impact: Stops 3D quadruped safely at x = 1.1920 m < 1.20 m wall with 100% contact forces inside Lorentz cone (f_z,min = 22.14 N) and zero pitch/roll angular velocity (1.64e-15 rad/s).

ideas.title: Slotine-Li Passivity & Adaptive Manipulator Trajectory Tracking
ideas.approach: Exploits skew-symmetry of dM/dt - 2C on sliding error s = dq_tilde + Lambda q_tilde to achieve dV/dt = -s^T K_D s <= 0 without inverting M(q), plus adaptive parameter regressor cancellation.

ideas.title: Multivariate Joseph MMSE Kalman Filter, Dual Steady-State DARE & Information Filter
ideas.approach: Matrix completion of squares on the Bucy-Joseph covariance update proving Loewner PSD dominance and trace optimality, plus ring-general Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury equivalence to the Information filter.

ideas.title: Continuous-Time CARE, HJB Calculus & Dual Kalman-Bucy Differential Filter
ideas.approach: Continuous Algebraic Riccati Equation completion of squares, HasDerivAt trajectory integration, and dual Kalman-Bucy differential covariance trace optimality.

ideas.title: POMDP Bayesian Belief Simplex & Smallwood-Sondik PWLC Bellman Backup
ideas.approach: Proves simplex invariance of Bayesian belief updates and convexity/PWLC preservation of alpha-vector value functions under Smallwood-Sondik dynamic programming backup.

ideas.title: Pareto-Optimal 7th-Order Septic Electromechanical Trajectory Family
ideas.approach: Proves cross-power orthogonality int_0^T a(t)j(t) dt = 0 on rest-to-rest trajectories and reduces motor Joule + viscous dissipation to exact rational quadratic forms in eta, strictly dominating 5th-order minimum-jerk.
ideas.measured_impact: Modest, practical energy reduction over 5th-order minimum-jerk in 6-DOF MuJoCo: -3.3% total motor I^2 R (gravity-dominated), -10.8% viscous loss (theoretical -10.79%), and -18.3% to -22.2% dynamic motion Joule heat (22.16% in 6-DOF due to lower mid-stroke Coriolis/centripetal cross-torques vs 18.33% 1D linear inertia theory).

ideas.title: 6-DOF SE(3) Log-Depth Homography-Based Visual Servoing (HBVS)
ideas.approach: Proves rotational invariance of log-depth feedback dd/dt = -lambda d ln(d/d*), convex trajectory lower bound, and eliminates the sec(theta/2)^2 camera-retreat divergence of classical IBVS.
ideas.measured_impact: Eliminates 5.76x (12.67 m) IBVS camera retreat under 155-deg optical-axis rotation in MuJoCo.

ideas.title: Byers-Nash n=6 Skew-Hamiltonian Conjecture (MF-13) & 15D Skew Parseval Decomposition
ideas.approach: Orthogonal Lyapunov decoupling on S_n (+) K_n, unconditional exclusion for rank(K) <= 4, 8-involution (F,G)-Klein Haar identity, complete 15D Parseval decomposition of K_6, and 10/10 exact rational LDL^T > 0 certificates on non-Common-T grid.
ideas.remaining_work: Analytical cross-term bound between the 1D W_pq-commuting (J) and 3D W_pq-anticommuting ({I_2, F, G}) off-diagonal subspaces when 1/2 ||Y_off||_F^2 > 3/4 ||Y_diag||_F^2.

ideas.title: Erdős #885 Genus-2 Quotient Tower, Absolute Jacobian Simplicity & Mumford/Cantor 2-Descent
ideas.approach: Projection tower from P^6 onto 15 elliptic + 7 genus-2 curves; symplectic Frobenius trace proof that End(J_Qbar) = Z for all 14 Class 1 & 2 Jacobians; Cassels-Flynn (x-T) squareness on single points, degree-2 Mumford divisors, and 3-/5-point Cantor reductions.
ideas.remaining_work: Formalize rank-1 Mordell-Weil generator certificate and p-adic Coleman integral zero bound on residue disks for k=5.

ideas.title: Erdős #273 p-1 Covering Systems & 23-Smooth Euler Threshold
ideas.approach: Weighted CRT density engine and prime-divisor sieve proving the exact 9-prime (23-smooth) Euler product threshold crossover 323323/110592 < 3 < 7436429/2433024.
ideas.remaining_work: Extend local branch-and-bound obstruction certificates beyond 23-smooth prime-shifted moduli.
